default.title: Iterative agents and exact CRM relationships
default.summary: Agents can now continue bounded checklist work into a concrete research or design deliverable, while CRM opportunities and interactions preserve exact account, contact, user, and navigation relationships across ClawPilot, SuiteCRM, and pipeline reporting.
features: A New opportunity workflow available to pipeline owners and editors
Tenant-scoped selection of existing CRM customer organizations
Inline customer organization creation without leaving the opportunity workflow
Configured product selection for new and existing opportunities
Immediate CRM-backed opportunity visibility while SuiteCRM and workbook synchronization continues
Expected close date and notes fields during opportunity creation
Visible pending and failed CRM synchronization counts
Bounded autonomous agent continuations that produce a persisted research or design deliverable and complete only evidenced checklist work
Exact many-to-many Contact relationships for Opportunities in ClawPilot and SuiteCRM
Organization-scoped Contact, controlled Type, and active ClawPilot Agent selectors for interactions
Administrator mapping from ClawPilot users to native SuiteCRM users
fixes: Preserves meaningful card descriptions up to 10,000 characters instead of replacing detailed scope with generic text
Prevents provider or worker transport success from marking requested work complete
Records exact task mutations as execution evidence and reports no deliverable changed when nothing persisted
Keeps autonomous work triaged, awaiting input, or blocked until separate completion evidence exists
Makes assignment retries idempotent so generated checklist items are not duplicated
Requires idempotency keys for opportunity creation to prevent duplicate CRM records after network retries
Makes opportunity creates and edits replay-safe so delayed retries cannot overwrite newer CRM changes
Displays persisted expected-close dates correctly when PostgreSQL returns date columns as JavaScript Date values
Persists product changes made from the opportunity drawer
Preserves blocked, awaiting-input, and triaged agent outcomes across worker retries and ignores stale dispatch results
Removes direct guessed Google Sheet row writes from opportunity creation and editing
Propagates Organization renames to pipeline opportunities and generated workbook projections through the canonical Organization relationship
Writes interaction Account and Contact relationships to SuiteCRM History while assigning the mapped native CRM user
Preserves past interaction dates through SuiteCRM synchronization by separating the Occurred At business timestamp from the Note creation timestamp
Opens Activity targets in the event's owning board or pipeline instead of the currently selected workspace resource
Keeps local development usable when hosted browser-session authentication is disabled
